title: Classifying Organic Compounds
subject: Chemistry
chapter: Organic Chemistry – Some Basic Principles and Techniques
objective: Millions of organic compounds, one first question: is the carbon chain open, or a ring? How to sort compounds into acyclic, alicyclic, aromatic and heterocyclic.

fill.q: Open-chain compounds are also called ____ compounds.
A ring of carbon atoms only, like cyclohexane, is ____.
A ring holding an atom other than carbon is ____.

tf.q: A branched chain is still acyclic.
Cyclohexene is aromatic because it has a double bond.
Furan has oxygen in its ring.

ar.r: Its carbon chain does not close into a ring.
Its ring contains a sulfur atom.

mcq.explain: A branch is still an open chain.

mcq.q: The first question when classifying is:

num.q: How many carbon atoms are in the ring of cyclohexane?
How many ring atoms does furan have?

short.q: Sort these: butane, cyclohexane, toluene, furan.
short.solution: Butane is acyclic, cyclohexane is alicyclic, toluene is aromatic, furan is heterocyclic.

left: O, N or S in the ring
